objective: Isolate the R686 donor versus scalar FP16 collector delta with actual donor intermediates and stage-wise rounding controls.

conclusion: R686's FP16/f64 delta came from the scalar oracle omitting GGML's Q8_0 quantization of F32 activation rows before each Q8_0 dot. Stage-wise FP16 controls do not close it; explicit quantization does. No FP16 compatibility mode is warranted by this fixture.
